description: Use when the user wants to see the news-feed view: markets that exhibited a probability spike in the chosen lookback window, scored by `|Δprob_pp| × log10(1+USD-equivalent volume)`. Refreshed after each Polymarket ingest cycle, typically every 15-20 min. The `window=` param selects the lookback: 24 (default, ≥15pp), 12 (≥12pp), or 2 (≥2h, ≥10pp); `prob_change` is measured over that window. Includes a `prob_history` array (24h bucketed trajectory) per row regardless of window. Filterable by `source=` and `categories=` (CSV). Soft flags (`is_entertainment`/`is_microprediction`/`is_crypto`/`is_sports`/`is_weather`) default OFF; opt in with `include_*=true`.

categories.description: Category filter (CSV). Examples: 'Politics', 'Sports', 'Crypto', 'Weather'. Maps to events.categories assignments.
categories.title: Categories

include_entertainment.description: Include entertainment markets (default: excluded for signal-to-noise).
include_entertainment.title: Include Entertainment

include_resolved.description: Include resolved (closed) markets (default: excluded — news movers focus on live markets).
include_resolved.title: Include Resolved

min_score.description: Minimum spike score. Higher = more notable spikes only.
min_score.title: Min Score

ordering.description: Sort order. Allowed values: `vol` (volume-weighted score; default), `score` (raw spike score), `prob` (probability change magnitude).
ordering.title: Ordering

q.description: Full-text search across market title and event title. Case-insensitive substring match.
q.title: Q

source.description: Platform ID(s); single value or comma-separated list. Allowed: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini.
source.title: Source

window.description:
Lookback windows the carousel selector exposes (hours). An IntEnum
(not Literal[2,12,24]) because FastAPI coerces a query STRING to an
IntEnum member but NOT to an int literal — `?window=24` would 422
against a Literal even though the Python default 24 validates.
window.title: SpikeWindow
